articles.summary: Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) Group President of Construction Industries Rod Shurman is expected to participate in a fireside chat hosted by Chad Dillard of Bernstein in North Carolina on Tuesday, Nov. 17, from 11:15 a.m. to noon ET. The discussion will provide updates on Construction Industries' growth initiatives, including Cat Compact™, the company's $1 billion investment to expand manufacturing capacity in North Carolina, Major Projects and more. A real-time video webcast will be available to the public. Participants should visit the website at least 15 minutes before the live event to download and install any necessary software. A transcript, audio and video will be posted afterward on Caterpillar's investor relations website, https://investors.caterpillar.com/events-presentations/default.aspx . articles.summary: Advanced collision warning and collision mitigation technologies will become standard on the majority of new Cat® construction machines throughout 2027 Technology helps enhance operator awareness, identify potential hazards and support safer jobsites Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) is making collision warning and collision mitigation technologies standard on the majority of new Cat ® construction machines throughout 2027. The move expands access to advanced safety technology that helps improve operator awareness and jobsite safety. Previously optional on select models and configurations, these technologies can help operators identify potential hazards and respond to changing conditions. Making these capabilities standard will help customers deploy advanced safety technology more consistently across their fleets. articles.summary: Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) has acquired John Fabick Tractor Company (Fabick), a long-standing Cat ® dealer with more than 100 years of trusted service and customer relationships across portions of Missouri, Illinois, the entire state of Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. Caterpillar entered into an agreement to acquire Fabick in September. The acquisition reflects a customer-focused decision to support a seamless transition of Fabick ownership while maintaining the strong service and local support customers know and value today. "Fabick customers have come to expect outstanding service and support, and completion of this acquisition ensures that commitment will continue," said Caterpillar Chairman and CEO Joe Creed. Upon closing, Caterpillar Senior Vice President Steve Ferguson has been appointed the new CEO and Dealer Principal of Fabick.
